purpose: Teach: 激変/奪取/過密/浸水/殿堂/リンチ/撃破/国力

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地域の治安が激変したケースを警察、ご対応中ですね
lines.en: So in this case, the precinct's security situation has shifted dramatically, hasn't it?
lines.style: Measured, observational. Leaning forward slightly with genuine curiosity. Speaking as someone gathering information carefully, not challenging. Warm but formal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現金奪取の強盗事件を捜査します
lines.en: We're currently investigating a robbery case—cash theft. That's the active priority.
lines.style: Professional, clear-eyed. Measured pace. Speaking as someone laying out facts without embellishment. Steady, direct eye contact. Not cold—just matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、過密地域での犯罪を警察、警戒されてますね
lines.en: I see. And in densely populated areas like this, crime prevention is clearly something the department keeps close watch on.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost careful with phrasing. Not quite a question—more like thinking aloud with respect. Soft, attentive. The tone of someone trying to understand the bigger picture.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、浸水家屋への防犯巡回を強化します
lines.en: We've increased patrols in flood-affected areas specifically. Crime prevention in vulnerable spaces is something we're strengthening.
lines.style: Assured and methodical. Each point lands with quiet conviction. Speaking as someone who's already thought this through. Composed, neither rushed nor hesitant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察殿堂に祀られる名捜査官の足跡を学びます
lines.en: There's a lot to learn, actually, from the work officers have done—cases that became landmark investigations, you know?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wistful. Slower pace on the middle section. Speaking like someone genuinely moved by the history of the work. Respectful, almost reverent.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、リンチ的私刑は許さず取り締まります
lines.en: Vigilante justice—mob violence, coerced confessions—we don't tolerate that. We crack down on it consistently.
lines.style: Firm, unyielding. Sharp attack on 「許さず」. Speaks with quiet moral certainty without sounding preachy. Professional spine stiffened. This is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯罪組織を撃破する作戦を警察、進められてますね
lines.en: And the department is working through operations to dismantle organized crime networks, I gather?
lines.style: Genuinely impressed, slightly deferential tone. Spoken as observation more than question. Leaning in. Warm respect underlying the formal phrasing. Engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、国力に応じた治安維持を続けます
lines.en: Security and order—we maintain that responsibility at the level the nation requires of us. It's ongoing.
lines.style: Composed, dignified. Speaking with the weight of institutional responsibility. Slow, deliberate pace. Not triumphant—grounded. The tone of someone who understands this is a long practice, not a victory.
